newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGE rises on SNCF telecom deal.
newsitem.headline: CGE rises on SNCF telecom deal.

text.p: Shares in Generale des Eaux rose by over four percent on the back of the company's being selected as the industrial partner to run the telecommunications network of French state railways SNCF.
Bouygues, which had been rumoured last week to have been the winner, fell by nearly five percent.
At 1019 GMT, Generale was up 35 francs at 811 while Bouygues was down 28 francs at 555 francs.
"It's good for Generale because it lands them a big network in their lap. It means a big gain in time and could reduce the investments needed," a dealer said.
"Bouygues, however, faces an uphill battle to be able to run a network in 1998," he added.
Generale des Eaux' Cegetel telecommunications unit aims the be the main rival to France Telecom when the market is liberalised in 1998.
